My dear Barton,

With reference to your letter dated December 16,
1935, I have to inform you that Jacob or Jaques Karp
arrived in Shanghai from Manila via Hongkong by the s.s.
"Empress of Russia" on December 15, 1935. He is at
present staying in the Palace Hotel, Room 207, but will
leave Shanghai for Dairen by the s.s. "Dairen Maru" on
December 21. As far as can be ascertained, he is not
engaged in any local activities.

Karp holds Latvian passport No. A007403 issued
in Paris on January 23, 1929. It bears a Chinese visa
issued by the Chinese Consulate-General in London on
October 2, 1925. In the Alien Declaration Form, Karp
described himself as a Latvian citizen, born in 1888 at
Riga, Latvia, and stated that he was proceeding to Dairen
on business as a manufacturer's representative.

Yours sincerely,

James Barton, Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General.

第 7400 号
日期 ____

1935 年 12 月 19 日。

亲爱的巴顿：

关于您 1935 年 12 月 16 日的来信，兹通知您，雅各布（Jacob）或雅克·卡普（Jaques Karp）已于 1935 年 12 月 15 日乘坐“俄罗斯皇后”号轮船（s.s. "Empress of Russia"），经香港从马尼拉抵达上海。他目前住在华懋饭店（Palace Hotel）207 室，但将于 12 月 21 日乘坐“大连丸”号轮船（s.s. "Dairen Maru"）离开上海前往大连。据查，他未参与任何本地活动。

卡普持有拉脱维亚护照，号码为 A007403，于 1929 年 1 月 23 日在巴黎签发。该护照贴有中国驻伦敦总领事馆于 1925 年 10 月 2 日签发的中国签证。在外侨申报表中，卡普自称为拉脱维亚公民，1888 年生于拉脱维亚里加，并称其作为制造商代表因公务前往大连。

此致
敬礼，

詹姆斯·巴顿先生，
英国驻上海总领事馆。

Date December 18, 1935.

Subject Communication dated December 16, 1935, from the British Consulate-
General re Jacob or Jaques Karp.

Made by D.S. Makaroff Forwarded by SBR **〔此处转录不清〕**

With reference to the attached communication from
the British Consulate-General on the subject of one Jacob
Karp, enquiries go to show that this individual arrived in
Shanghai from Manila, P.I. via Hongkong in the s.s. "Empress
of Russia" on December 15, 1935.

In the Alien Declaration Form of the Public Safety
Bureau, Passport Office, Jacob Karp stated that he was a
Latvian citizen, born in 1888 at Riga, Latvia, and that he
was proceeding to Dairen on business as manufacturer's
representative.

He is in possession of a Latvian passport No.A007403,
issued in Paris on January 23, 1929, which document bears a
Chinese visa issued by the Chinese Consulate-General in London
on October 2, 1925.

At present J. Karp is residing at the Palace Hotel,
Room No.207, and is expected to leave Shanghai for Dairen in
the s.s. "Dairen Maru" on December 21.

As far as can be ascertained, he is not engaged in
any local activities.

N. MaFang
D. S.
D.C. (Special Branch)

报告
日期：1935 年 12 月 18 日。

事由：关于英国总领事馆 1935 年 12 名 16 日就雅各布（Jacob）或雅克（Jaques）·卡普一事发出的公函。

由 D.S. 马卡罗夫（Makaroff）撰写，经 SBR **〔此处转录不清〕** 转呈

关于附上的英国总领事馆就雅各布·卡普（Jacob Karp）一事发出的公函，经查询，此人于 1935 年 12 月 15 日乘坐“俄罗斯皇后”号轮船，经香港从菲律宾群岛马尼拉抵达上海。

在公共安全局护照办公室的外侨申报表中，雅各布·卡普称其为拉脱维亚公民，1888 年生于拉脱维亚里加，并称其作为制造商代表因公务前往大连。

他持有拉脱维亚护照，号码为 A007403，于 1929 年 1 月 23 日在巴黎签发，该证件贴有中国驻伦敦总领事馆于 1925 年 10 月 2 日签发的中国签证。

目前 J. 卡普居住在华懋饭店（Palace Hotel）207 室，预计将于 12 月 21 日乘坐“大连丸”号轮船离开上海前往大连。

据查，他未参与任何本地活动。

N. MaFang
侦探警长（D. S.）
特别分部副督察（D.C. (Special Branch)）

H.B.M. Consulate General,
Shanghai.
16th December, 1935.

My dear Givens,
A man named JACOB or JACUES KARP, holder of
Latvian passport No.A007403 issued in Paris, January 23,
1929, aged 45, arrived in Shanghai on board the "Empress
of Russia" on December 15th, probably from Manila. I
shall be very grateful for any information you can let
me have regarding this man's whereabouts and activities
in Shanghai.

Yours sincerely,
〔签名〕

T. P. Givens, Esquire,
SHANGHAI.

S2.
For attention please.
〔签名〕

DS Nakamura
DBR 14/12.

上海。
1935 年 12 月 16 日。

亲爱的吉文斯：

一名名为雅各布（JACOB）或雅克（JACUES）·卡普的男子，持有 1929 年 1 月 23 日在巴黎签发的拉脱维亚护照（号码 A007403），年龄 45 岁，于 12 月 15 日乘坐“俄罗斯皇后”号抵达上海，可能来自马尼拉。如蒙告知此人在上海的行踪及活动情况，我将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼，
〔签名〕

T. P. 吉文斯先生，
上海。

S2.
请予关注。
〔签名〕

DS 中村（Nakamura）
